_comment: Canonical AC harmonic test case shared by the C++ solver, the independent numpy reference, and the OpenDSS cross-check. One source of truth so all three solve the IDENTICAL network. Two-bus radial feeder: SLACK source (sub-transient reactance x'') -- series line -- nonlinear load modelled as a Norton harmonic current source (no shunt-impedance load model, so the load is a pure current injector that maps cleanly onto OpenDSS).
